entries.en:
A City Bayfront Land Development, Development Manager Hebisaki

President Busujima,
Regarding the land development near B Beach in A City, I am reporting on the chemicals
above the standard limits that were detected in the reclaimed soil.

Following renewed advice from Professor D of C University and Mr. E of the survey agency,
we conducted 12 surveys in total and were able to obtain values at an acceptable level.
We believe these values will have no impact on the ecosystem or scenery of B Beach,
or at most an extremely minor one.

This survey will not affect the development schedule.
We will also pay advisory fees to Professor D and Mr. E for their cooperation.
That is all.
entries.notes: Natural English, coverage audit 2026-10-24 (opening, objectives, options, memo).
